newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Polisa insurer plans high yearly dividends.
newsitem.headline: Polish Polisa insurer plans high yearly dividends.

text.p: Polish insurance firm TUR Polisa SA, which sees mid-November listing, plans to earmark up to half of its profits for paying dividends in the next few years, the firm's president Stanislaw Gutek told Reuters.

"We will pay dividends every year ... the question is how much, but our goal is to make shareholders have better profits from our shares than from investments in a bank ... earmarking one third or a half of our profits for payouts," he said.
So far Polisa, which has been operating for the last five and a half years, earmarked 90-95 percent of its profits for dividends.
It is the third largest insurance company in Poland in terms of market share after the state-owned giant PZU SA and the listed Warta.
Polisa had a net profit of 2.6 million zlotys in 1995 on net premiums of 103.9 million zlotys.
